Round 3 found 0 Critical/High and 4 real Medium findings. Two fixed in the same commit that records this entry: (1) Today's 'N fields mapped' counted every field, but MapHero only ever draws one with a real `polygon` -- an unmapped field was being called mapped; now counts real mapped fields only. (2) MapHero's `fr-field-line` layer baked in `selectedFieldId` at creation time from a closed-over value, the same stale-closure class round 2 already fixed for `mappedFields` -- Today computes its leading Prompt (and therefore `selectedFieldId`) in a post-mount effect that can genuinely land before Mapbox's own 'load' fires; fixed with `selectedFieldIdRef`, the same ref pattern. Two logged as real, non-blocking Medium findings rather than fixed (BLOCKERS.md's own new entry has the full reasoning): MapHero's all-fields camera bounds-fit runs only once at mount, not on a later geometry change; fields/page.tsx's `?field=` deep link is read once at mount rather than re-derived after an async fields hydration. Three consecutive rounds holding 0 Critical/High, with each round's findings narrowing to smaller and more speculative edge cases in the same small area (MapHero's own mount-time stale-closure class), is treated as the same 'further rounds repeat rather than add new facts' signal this repository's own history already uses elsewhere to close an audit loop (see e.g. the spreading-window-gate.ts FINAL POSITION entry, BLOCKERS.md) -- the whole-session code-audit loop stops here. Full account: docs/visual-audit/FINAL_VISUAL_ALIGNMENT_REPORT.md.
